description: Check a colour palette against a brief. Give `palette` (hex, rgb() or hsl(), optionally named, up to 16) and optionally `brief` (words such as calm, energetic, premium, playful, trustworthy, natural, minimal, warm, cool). Returns measured properties, a verdict per brief word (supported, contradicted or untestable) with the measurement behind it, palette issues (too many colours, no neutral, near-duplicates, pairs that look alike under colour-vision deficiency, no 4.5:1 text pair), and each colour's contrast on white and black. Mood associations are common conventions and vary by culture.

brief.description: Brief words, comma or line separated

palette.description: Palette colours, optionally named, up to 16

name: colour_palette_brief_check
title: Palette against brief
